name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialized sub-brands (Profusion for data analytics, Amplify Analytix for experience intelligence) targeting financial services with GenAI-powered customer analytics. Their methodology centers on data-driven customer intelligence platforms for banking and insurance, leveraging AI to derive actionable insights from behavioral and transactional data. Delivery model combines proprietary analytics platforms with consulting services across EU and India markets. Thought leadership themes focus on Experience Intelligence, AI-augmented decisioning for financial services, and predictive customer behavior modeling.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta differentiates through deep dual-ecosystem expertise in SAP and Qualtrics, embedding experience management directly into SAP business processes via BTP. Their methodology focuses on operationalizing XM data within enterprise workflows, making experience insights actionable at the point of business decision-making. AI approach centers on intelligent agents within SAP environments that automate experience-driven actions. Delivery model targets DACH enterprises in manufacturing and financial services with integrated SAP-Qualtrics solutions. Thought leadership emphasizes closing the gap between experience data collection and operational response.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics positions as the premier Qualtrics implementation partner for GCC government and public sector CX transformation. Their methodology emphasizes citizen experience maturity frameworks aligned to national digital transformation strategies (Vision 2030, UAE Smart Government). AI approach integrates Qualtrics AI capabilities within public sector feedback and service design workflows. Delivery model combines Qualtrics technical implementation with strategic CX consulting for large-scale government programs. Thought leadership themes center on citizen experience measurement, public service design, and national CX benchmarking.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages its global research infrastructure to deliver CX measurement and analytics at scale, differentiating through proprietary research methodologies and massive consumer panel data. Their approach combines traditional market research rigor with modern CX analytics, focusing on experience ROI quantification and loyalty economics. Medallia platform integration provides the technology backbone for their managed CX programs. Delivery model spans managed services, strategic consulting, and syndicated research across all major industry verticals globally. Thought leadership emphasizes evidence-based CX strategy grounded in behavioral science and econometric modeling.

name: commonFont

Their methodology emphasizes AI-powered experience orchestration, leveraging Qualtrics AI agents to automate and personalize customer journeys in banking. Delivery model combines Qualtrics technical implementation, program optimization, and strategic CX advisory focused on the US enterprise market. Thought leadership themes center on Qualtrics AI agent deployment, closed-loop experience management, and financial services CX transformation. Their content demonstrates strong technical depth in Qualtrics platform capabilities.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap operates as a platform-agnostic CX and EX consulting firm serving Spain and Latin America with methodology-driven customer journey design and organizational transformation. Their approach emphasizes human-centered design, employee experience as a driver of customer experience, and change management as integral to CX program success. Unlike technology-led competitors, Lukkap positions on strategic consulting and journey methodology rather than specific platform implementations. Delivery model combines strategic advisory, journey mapping workshops, and organizational transformation programs. Thought leadership themes span customer journey innovation, employee engagement, talent experience, and cultural transformation.

name: Izo

AI approach integrates Qualtrics AI capabilities within VoC programs for automated insights and text analytics. Thought leadership emphasizes CX maturity models, customer-centric culture transformation, and digital experience design for Spanish-speaking enterprise markets.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant's Connected Experiences Studio sits within a massive global technology services organization that leads with AI-first enterprise transformation messaging. AI approach emphasizes generative AI engineering, AI-powered digital products, and enterprise-scale AI adoption frameworks. Delivery model leverages global engineering talent at scale for end-to-end digital experience build-outs. CX thought leadership is subsumed within the larger AI and digital transformation narrative, making dedicated CX positioning less visible compared to specialized CX consultancies.
